segments.text: This is my newest obsession, my mini garden.
And yes, this is a real garden from Click and Grow.
and I've been really wanting to grow my own herbs
but I don't have a ton of space.
I don't have a green thumb.
And now this is letting me grow all my own herbs
We have some lemon bombs, some Tulsi, some peppermint.
and the garden waters them automatically.
You literally just fill up the water tank,
plug it in and let it do its thing.
So now I can grow my own tea and herbs
right at home all year round.
If you wanna grow your own little indoor garden,
I would definitely go check this out at clickandgrow.com.
